About the show

Recommended Age Guide 14+ In Thanks for Being Here, your presence is crucial. Ontroerend Goed, internationally renowned for their ground-breaking theatre, celebrates theatre’s most essential element: the audience. In this witty and ingenious play of video and viewpoints, they blur the boundaries...
